attributes.title: 72nd AAEP Annual Convention & Trade Show
attributes.summary:
The 72nd AAEP Annual Convention takes place December 7 to 11, 2026, at Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas, with the trade show open December 7 to 10. Unlike earlier years, activities begin on a Monday. In-person registration covers more than 110 hours of equine CE, and a virtual option is also sold.

AAEP says the program has been submitted for RACE approval but is not yet approved; nearly 60 hours are approved by HISA for racetrack veterinarians. Member registration is $775 through December 2 and $875 afterward; non-members pay $1,195 or $1,295. Mandalay Bay is the headquarters hotel.
